# Peter J. Winslow

> Peter J. Winslow is a fifth-year PhD candidate in the Department of Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, and Biophysics at the University of Minnesota, advised by Burckhard Seelig and affiliated with the BioTechnology Institute. Research areas: protein sequence space, the origin of life, new-to-nature proteins, and protein design, studied with reduced amino acid alphabets, biophysical characterization, X-ray crystallography, and protein language models.

- [Home](https://pjwinslow.github.io/PJWinslow-website/): biography and research interests
- [Research](https://pjwinslow.github.io/PJWinslow-website/#research): current projects
- [Publications](https://pjwinslow.github.io/PJWinslow-website/#publications): coming soon
- [Presentations](https://pjwinslow.github.io/PJWinslow-website/#presentations): talks and posters
- Funding: NASA FINESST, NNH23ZDA001N-FINESST 23-PLANET23-0058
- [In the media](https://pjwinslow.github.io/PJWinslow-website/#media): "Science fiction to science fact" (College of Biological Sciences, September 2024), a recorded AbGradCon 2024 talk (NASA Astrobiology livestream), and a 2023 Three-Minute Thesis talk that won the College of Biological Sciences round (University of Minnesota Graduate School, YouTube)
